label: Customer reports
description: Customer activity for a single reporting period.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Human-readable label for the reporting period.

fields.label: Period start
fields.description: When the period starts (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Period end
fields.description: When the period ends (shown in your local time). Orders from this moment on fall in the next period.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency the amounts are reported in.

fields.label: Customers
fields.description: Different customers who placed at least one paid order in this period. Guest checkouts aren't counted.

fields.label: Previous period customers
fields.description: The same count for the period just before this one: the previous day, week or 14 days, or the previous calendar month.

fields.label: Change vs previous period
fields.description: Percentage change in customers compared with the previous period.

fields.label: New customers
fields.description: Customers whose first ever paid order was in this period.

fields.label: Returning customers
fields.description: Customers who had already placed a paid order before this period.

fields.label: Repeat buyers
fields.description: Customers who placed two or more paid orders in this period.

fields.label: Repeat rate %
fields.description: Share of this period's customers who are repeat buyers.

fields.label: Returning rate %
fields.description: Share of this period's customers who are returning customers.

fields.label: Average spend per customer
fields.description: Total spent by this period's customers, less refunds, divided by the number of customers.

fields.label: Customer report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this period. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.

params.note: This period, or the one before it used for comparison, had more customers or orders than the report reads, so some figures cover only part of it and the counts are a lower bound.

rows.label: Customers
rows.hint: Different customers who placed at least one paid order in this period. Guest checkouts aren't counted.

rows.label: Previous period
rows.hint: The same count for the period just before this one: the previous day, week or 14 days, or the previous calendar month.

rows.label: Change vs previous period
rows.hint: Percentage change in customers compared with the previous period.

rows.label: New customers
rows.hint: Customers whose first ever paid order was in this period.

rows.label: Returning customers
rows.hint: Customers who had already placed a paid order before this period.

rows.label: Returning rate
rows.hint: Share of this period's customers who are returning customers.

rows.label: Repeat buyers
rows.hint: Customers who placed two or more paid orders in this period.

rows.label: Repeat rate
rows.hint: Share of this period's customers who are repeat buyers.

rows.label: Average spend per customer
rows.hint: Total spent by this period's customers, less refunds, divided by the number of customers.

fields.label: Top customers
fields.description: The customers who spent the most in this period, up to 10. Amounts are paid orders less refunds. Click a name to open their customer page.

params.empty: No customers placed a paid order in this period, or Include top customers is turned off in the app settings.

fields.label: Partial
fields.description: Set when a read hit its page ceiling, so counts are a lower bound.
